title: Impact of Choice Order on Environmental Purchases
content: In surveys, the sequence in which options are presented often influences decision-making patterns. Academic research corroborates this trend, suggesting that the placement of choices, whether first or last, can influence selection outcomes. This article explores how research into choice order affects consumer purchasing decisions, particularly when weighing the environmental impact against product quality.
